note: V030B source-only slice in V030A-owned index.rs. Isolated SQLite fixture; ACL allowlist before limit/count/pagination; partial coverage if caller reports incomplete source coverage or any allowed transcript is truncated. Shared schema remains Terra-owned.

changes.result: Source-only V030B committed as d7d6cbee in crates/herder/src/search/index.rs. Added serializable search_page/SearchPage/SearchHit/SearchCoverage API. It receives the trusted ACL allowlist as full SessionAddress values and applies that set in SQL to both count and hit query before ORDER/LIMIT/OFFSET; count and pages contain authorized sessions only. Coverage is partial when caller source coverage is incomplete or any allowlisted session's transcript is marked truncated; total_hits is documented as a lower bound for partial coverage. update_session persists content_truncated with snapshot state. Isolated rusqlite harness: 10 passed (7 index + 3 address), evidence review-evidence/v030b/search-acl-coverage.log. Not integrated into crate/store schema/export, no production or consumer proof; Terra owns v4 migration/fence/export. Parent V030 remains open.
